title: The workflow roles and personas
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0053 no longer matches the current design.
decision: Generic holders: lead (owns a cut's realization), builder (one work package), assayer (judges a cut; never builds or repairs it), illustrator (examples cold from concepts only), check-writer (the checks that bind examples before the build). The illustrator, check-writer and assayers run on another model family than the builders where one is available (0146). Personas over the architect, each named for its expertise: kino (film production), nico (the corpus's concept space and the cold-decode oracle), mav (any software repository). Which persona or architect holds a context is recorded with each cut; for cratylus's own contexts it is the architect.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
